scope.parameterEligibility: Accepted table policy, implemented scalar kind, and at least one bundled base layout. Other parameters remain outside this matrix.
scope.curveOracle: Fixed normalized positions plus independent endpoint interpolation; one wire LSB tolerance for floating point/quantized historical displays.
scope.limits: Chorus/Drive type policy, Delay/Reverb and Flanger/Phaser/Compressor/Wah/Tremolo final model/selector predicates, 21 tempo pairs and read-only modifier targets enforced. Delay/Reverb/Flanger/Phaser/Compressor/Wah/Tremolo model/internal-selector writes require full templates. Rotary has no model selector; Pitch TYPE requires templates. Pitch custom notes require final-scale context; fixed slots remain blocked. Its 34 integer/nonzero-enum fields use the pinned preset-word overlay and are tested on discrete domains, never normalized curves. Global scale contents and actual arpeggiator playback remain unvalidated. Exclusions counted separately; scalar conformance is not unconditional write permission. No arbitrary preset, other-family visibility, automatic compressor timing/makeup, DSP/audio/CPU, effective tempo/controller evaluation or routing validation.

algorithmApplicability.rule: Read final channel model and internal selector separately. Require their captured-template binding. Model/internal selector changes use full templates, never scalar writes. Explicit page alternatives override empty or unqualified fallbacks within the same pageNum. Control predicates intersect page visibility.
algorithmApplicability.limits: Bounded XML-derived authoring policy; native UI and DSP not executed. Internal enum without labels is read as a raw selector, never as a continuous scalar. Reverb XML IDs 9/10 are outside the FW13 cache and are not supported. Template defaults do not prove every value. Other families and additional dependencies remain separate.

modulationDynamics.rule: Use final channel state and complete captured model/selector bindings. Model and Phaser Mode changes require full templates. Compile firmware-active variants, pages and control predicates. Native Flanger names resolve to verified PIDs; preserve exact legacy names and scalar definitions.
modulationDynamics.limits: Bounded XML-derived authoring policy; no native UI or DSP execution. No new device measurements or scale promotion. Automatic compressor timing/makeup, envelope/LFO dynamics and other dependencies are not evaluated. Meters and unused words are not write controls.

presetWordCodecs.scope: Preset storage only. FW13 cache bounds and labels, FM3 native symbol bindings, existing FW13 templates and older FM3 factory words. Structural/file cross-check, not a new hardware sweep or MIDI SET codec.
presetWordCodecs.numericEnumInput: Stored option ID, not zero-based list position. TRACKMODE: NOTES=1, CHORDS=2. TEMPO: first label=1, last=78; NONE is unavailable.
presetWordCodecs.limits: Seven local custom notes require final-state context validation. No global scale contents, tonic authoring, device import, audio/CPU or effective controller/tempo evaluation. Same descriptor class is transferred across the explicitly listed 20 signed fields; factory facts are not per-value measurements.

rotaryPitch.rule: Pitch TYPE requires full templates; final-channel FW13 variants govern controls. Rotary has no model selector: PID 0 is Rate. Apply the pinned 34-field preset-word overlay; seven custom notes also require complete final-scale validation. Fixed slots, including Tonic, remain blocked. Global scale indices do not include global scale contents.
rotaryPitch.limits: Metadata and firmware-derived authoring gates, not native UI/DSP or hardware execution. Global scale contents, arpeggiator playback semantics and Learn/controller dynamics remain unverified. No live MIDI SET claim. Existing tempo/modifier guards remain required.

typeApplicability.rule: Explicit writes checked against final per-channel type; stored hidden words preserved
typeApplicability.limits: Bounded XML-derived authoring policies, not executed native UI or DSP validation. Chorus/Drive coverage is in families; Delay/Reverb in algorithmApplicability; Flanger/Phaser/Compressor/Wah/Tremolo in modulationDynamics. Rotary/Pitch includes type-free Rotary, 16 Pitch models and a separately pinned 34-field preset-word overlay; seven local custom-note fields require final-scale validation; fixed Pitch slots remain blocked. Tempo/modifier scope is reported separately; other-family visibility remains unverified.

dependencies.modifierMode: read-only; reject explicit writes to active or uncertain targets
dependencies.limits: 21 bounded tempo pairs in nine families, not all FM3 dependencies. Other-family type visibility, effective BPM-derived values and controller dynamics remain unverified.
